title: SubscribeCOV confirmed subscription request
purpose: Exercise confirmed subscription service entry with standard BVLC NPDU APDU layering for subscribe-cov service choice.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP endpoint should recognize the frame as confirmed request for SubscribeCOV service and continue into service decoding, responding according to implementation support.
constraints_preserved: BVLC header present as required by supplied BACnet/IP layering overview.
BVLC total length field 0x001C matches the 28-byte message size.
NPDU included between BVLC and APDU per supplied layered structure.
APDU first octet uses confirmed-request high nibble 0x0 per supplied PDU type reference.
Service choice byte 0x0C matches SubscribeCOV per supplied confirmed service catalog.
Assumed BVLC function 0x0a is Original-Unicast-NPDU based on conservative BACnet/IP prior.
Assumed NPDU version 0x01 and control 0x04 without routing fields are valid common BACnet/IP defaults.
Service parameter tags and lengths after the service choice are conservative inferred BACnet application/context encodings.
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability claim is made. Seed is intended only for normal parser coverage with consistent outer framing.
